title: Delightful evening
text: Xavier was an exceptional guide.  Great personality, good sense of humor and knowledge of history of the Gothic district.  He hosted us to a Tapas dinner with wine which was an absolute delight.  The Flamenco show was good but I wouldn't say great.  I am keeping his name handy in case I make another trip to the area.  He is my go to person if I need a guide and will share his name with family if they make a trip to the area.  A great experience.
author: Valerie_R

title: 10 stars!
text: This was a last minute booking and I am so glad we booked it.  Our was very knowledgeable and is a born Catalan.  He was informative and passionate about his culture and we learned a lot.  Our meal was top notch and he took the liberties of ordering based on our discussions and it was amazing.  The Flamenco was on a different level. Very traditional and we had front row seats!

title: Lovely evening
text:
Feliciano was our guide for the evening. He is enthusiastic about his beautiful city and region of Catalonia.  He shared with us the history of Barcelona with interesting stories. The restaurant that we had tapas in was excellent. He then brought us to an intimate venue for the flamenco show. It was very good.
Thank you for sharing your city with us
author: 4paws4hoofs

title: A Night to Remember!
text: Our guide, Feliciano, met my husband and I at our hotel and we were quickly having a fun, informative tour of the older parts of Barcelona.  Feliciano was so friendly and fun that we felt like a friend was showing us around - we even stopped in a candy shop for free samples!  Feliciano took us to Tapeo where a long line was waiting to get in, but he had reservations and a table waiting for us.  All the tapas (and there were a lot) that we sampled were delicious. text: Miguel was an amazing tour guide from explaining the gothic quarter to ordering the best tapas at an authentic tapas restaurant to securing VIP tickets to a Flomenco show. You have made our Barcelona trip unforgettable. Thank you!

author: ibtravis

title: Excellent Private Tour
text: Javier was our wonderful guide. He was friendly and extremely knowledgeable. He met us at our hotel and gave us a detailed tour of the city. He took us through quiet city back streets and showed us places only the locals know about. We then ate a delicious tapas dinner at a local restaurant followed by a flamenco dance. We felt like we got to experience an authentic taste of Barcelona! We could not have asked for a better experience.
author: Susan P

title: Authentic, exciting experience.
text: We enjoyed this private walking tour immensely. The guide was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. We had plenty of time to enjoy a very beautiful area a Barcelona and a wonderful dinner. The guide chose traditional dishes for us and it was a really fun experience dining with her. The Flamenco show was professional and traditional - not the ordinary run of the mill show. I would recommend this tour to anyone who wants a taste of one of the best parts of Barcelona.
author: Mary_W
